params.1273: Deal with the pact member in the first catacomb chamber.
params.1292: Completing this Task will take you one step further in the Blood Pact quest.
params.1274: Rangers are best dealt with by using melee attacks such as daggers, swords or unarmed combat.
params.1275: You can avoid attack by running up the side of the room.
params.1276: Click on the ranger to attack him.
